exceptions.scope: app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml cleartext support for local SSDP description fetches
exceptions.reason: Compatibility exception, not a false positive: TvDiscovery fetches HTTP device descriptions from dynamically discovered private IP literals. parsePacket requires the expected LG service and the advertising private host, rejects user-info/fragments, and the discovery client disables proxies and redirects and bounds response size/time. These requests carry no pairing credentials; metadata remains unauthenticated. TV control and icons require the paired WSS/HTTPS origin, and weather search uses HTTPS without redirects. Disabling cleartext globally would break existing discovery; static domain entries cannot enumerate users' dynamic TV addresses. Re-review on network-client or endpoint-policy changes.
